headline: Thorvaldsen injured as AZ host Twente with 3 points between them
summary: AZ Alkmaar host Twente on Sunday with only 3 points between them in the Eredivisie, and Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen is injured, Dutch outlet Drimble reports. Last week Twente lost 1-2 at home to Utrecht. Yet they have allowed chances worth just 0.77 goals a game in their last five, which explains why the market rates AZ only about a quarter of a goal better. AZ's win chance is 43.5%, Twente's 31.3%, and the total goals line sits at 3.25.
read: AZ Alkmaar are second in the Eredivisie and at home, and the market makes them favourites at 43.5% — but only a quarter of a goal better than a Twente side that has conceded five goals in its last five games. AZ drew 2-2 at Cambuur last weekend, Twente lost 1-2 at home to Utrecht, and a goals line of 3.25 with both teams to score at 66.2% points to an open game.

facts.fact: AZ Alkmaar are the market favourites at 43.5% to win, with Twente on 31.3%.
The handicap fair line is AZ -0.25 — a quarter of a goal.
facts.meaning: On the pitch the market rates these two almost level; a draw would mean AZ backers only half-lose the handicap.

facts.fact: Twente's last five opponents have averaged just 0.77 xG.
facts.meaning: Chances are hard to come by against them — the main reason this is priced as a near-even game rather than a home walkover.

facts.fact: AZ have 20 points from nine league games and sit second; Twente are fifth on 17.
facts.meaning: Three points separate them — a meeting of two of the league's top five, closer than a home fixture usually looks.

facts.fact: Twente lost 1-2 at home to Utrecht on 18 October.
facts.meaning: It ended a run of three wins and a draw and was only their second league defeat of the season.

facts.fact: Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel for the Conference League trip to Gibraltar because of injury.
facts.meaning: He is the club's most expensive arrival — a significant absentee if the problem stretches to this fixture.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 3.25, with over priced at 47.5%.
facts.meaning: A high line — the market is pricing an open game, while leaning narrowly to under three and a quarter.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 66.2%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that both sides find the net, even against Twente's mean defensive run.

sources.fact: AZ Alkmaar are third in the Eredivisie and were held to a draw at Cambuur on October 18, dropping points just as PSV had the day before.
AZ needed a late rescue to escape defeat at SC Cambuur, drawing after having lost their previous league match.
AZ were beaten by Sunderland in the Europa League, according to a Sunderland fan photo feature recalling a narrow win over the Dutch Cup winners.
FC Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel to Gibraltar for the Conference League match against Lincoln Red Imps because of injury, Dutch outlet Drimble reports.
Erik ten Hag is now technical director at FC Twente, and this week he criticised the state of Manchester United, according to the Manchester Evening News.
